To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the electrical wear behavior of the Cu-Cr precipitation hardened copper alloy is studied by using electrical sliding-wearing test.The wear rate of copper alloy increases with the increasing of sliding distance and the decreasing of Cr-content.The adhesive wear is dominant wear mechanism.
the wear rate is increased with increasing sliding distance and decreased with the increase of chromium content.
the electrical wear behavior of copper alloy is influenced by its composition.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the wear behavior of Cu alloy under electrical sliding condition, and the wear rate and wear mechanisms were studied.
the electrical wear behavior and its abrasion mechanism of Cu-Cr alloys, and the results provide a theoretical basis for improving the wear resistance of the alloys.
the wear behavior of Cu-0%Cr, Cu-0.63Cr, Cu- 0.65Cr, Cu-1Cr, Cu-2Cr, Cu-3Cr, Cu-5Cr alloys under electrical sliding wear condition, and the wear mechanisms of these alloys were analyzed.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Cr element can effectively reduce the electrical wear rate of copper alloy.
Cu-0.75Cr alloy has a good wear resistance in the condition of 1.2 A current and 1.2 N load.
the addition of Cr to Cu can improve the wear resistance of the alloy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the addition of Cr into copper matrix can effectively improve the wear resistance of the alloy, and Cr-content of the alloy is an important factor affecting its wear behavior.
the electrical wear resistance of Cu-0Cr alloy increases with the decrease of the Cr content and the increase of the sliding distance.
the wear rate is closely related to the Cr-content and sliding distance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of Cr element can improve the electrical sliding wear resistance of Cu-Cr alloys.
the wear rate is reduced when the Cr-content is increased from 0.65 to 0.76, and further increased to 0.86, and the wear mechanism is changed from adhesive wear to abrasive wear.
the addition of Cr can improve the wear resistance of Cu-Cr alloys.
